COMMANDS_PAGE.TITLE: Command List
COMMANDS_PAGE.SUBTITLE: Discover all the features our bot offers for your e-sports analysis.

REGISTER_TEAM.NAME: /register-team
REGISTER_TEAM.DESCRIPTION: Opens an interactive form to register a new team and its players in the analysis system. This is the first step to start collecting data.

STATUS_TEAM.NAME: /status team
STATUS_TEAM.DESCRIPTION: Provides a full analysis dashboard for a specific team, with subcommands for overview, brawler performance, and map performance.

OPTIONS.TEAM_NAME: The name of the registered team you want to analyze.
